## Summary

I've fixed the authorization vulnerability in the post deletion endpoint. The `PostController.destroy()` method in `app/Http/Controllers/PostController.ts` was missing the authorization check that already exists in the `edit()` and `update()` methods.

**Change made:** Added `await this.authorize('delete', [Post, post])` to line 102 of the destroy method, right before deleting the post. This leverages the existing `PostPolicy.delete()` method which correctly verifies that only the post's author can delete it.

**Effect:**
- Only the post's author can delete their own posts
- Authenticated users who are not the author will receive a 403 Forbidden response
- Unauthenticated users will be redirected to login
- The authorization now matches the pattern used for update operations

TypeScript type checking passes and all tests pass (2 pass, 0 fail).
